---
title: "The kompreni-offer mod"
subtitle: "Optional buttons above Claude Code's prompt box."
---

A mod is a plugin that changes Claude Code's own interface. The kompreni-offer mod shows a row above the prompt whenever Claude isn't working. It counts the files changed since the last explanation, and has depth and level pickers and **Explain**, **Walkthrough** and **Code tour** buttons that fill in the command for you. Kompreni works fine without it.

![The row above the prompt in VS Code: "18 files changed in this conversation", Depth and Level pickers, and Explain, Walkthrough, Code tour and Dismiss buttons](images/mod/row.png)

After the first explanation, a **Scope** picker appears above Depth.

When there's nothing new to explain, the row shrinks to one line, and Explain uses your remembered depth and level. After an explanation, this row has a **Whole conversation** button, which opens the full row with that scope chosen.

![The one-line form of the row: "no file edits seen in this conversation", with Explain, Walkthrough, Code tour and Dismiss buttons](images/mod/row-one-line.png)

## Install

```text
/plugin install kompreni-offer@kompreni
```

You need a Claude Code version with mod support (built and tested against 2.1.331), and the `kompreni` plugin. See [Install](install.qmd) for the marketplace step, updating and removing it.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Mods aren't sandboxed
Mods are a new, evolving part of Claude Code, and run as code inside it. Read [`hooks/register.tsx`](https://github.com/Bergam0t/kompreni-claude-code-skill/blob/main/mods/kompreni-offer/hooks/register.tsx) before installing it.
:::

## The buttons

**Explain** fills your prompt box with the command, e.g. `/kompreni:explain depth=deep level=new-to-language`. You press Enter. It never submits for you, and it never overwrites a draft you've started.

**Walkthrough** and **Code tour** do the same for `/kompreni:walkthrough`. **Code tour** adds `code=all`. Both use your level, and your depth only if it's `standard` or `deep` (otherwise the skill sizes the walkthrough itself). They never pass a scope: a walkthrough covers the whole conversation. The two buttons appear only if the walkthrough skill is installed.

## The pickers

The depth and level you pick are remembered across sessions. Each picker's **auto** option says what it does: depth is picked from the size of the change, and level is intermediate unless this conversation, your `CLAUDE.md` or Claude's memory says something about your experience (e.g. "I'm new to Python"). The explanation's first line says which level it used and where that came from.

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
![The Depth picker open: auto (picked from the size of the change), brief, standard, deep](images/mod/depth-picker.png)
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
![The Level picker open: auto (intermediate, unless this chat, CLAUDE.md or memory says otherwise), new-to-programming, new-to-language, intermediate, advanced](images/mod/level-picker.png)
:::
:::

After the first explanation, the **Scope** picker offers *since last explanation* (the default) or *whole conversation*, which fills in `scope=all` and counts every file changed in the session. The choice lasts for the session only.

## The count

The count matches what the skill will explain: files edited since the last Kompreni explanation in this session, across however many turns. It resets when an explanation or a walkthrough actually runs, whether you used a button, typed the command, or asked Claude in words. History-mode runs (`branch=`, `since=`, `commit=`) don't reset it. Dismissing the row doesn't reset the count either.

## When it shows

- `show=always`, the default: whenever Claude isn't working, even before any edits (in the one-line form). This is still useful because edits made through shell commands aren't counted, but the skill finds them in git. **Dismiss** hides the row until the next turn finishes.
- `show=changes`: only after a turn in which Claude edited files. **Dismiss** hides the row until the next turn that edits something.

## Settings

```text
/kompreni-offer                                   # show current settings
/kompreni-offer off                               # hide the row entirely (on to resume)
/kompreni-offer show=changes                      # only after turns that edit files (show=always to go back)
/kompreni-offer depth=brief
/kompreni-offer level="fluent in R, new to Python"
/kompreni-offer command=kompreni-explain          # force which skill command to use
```

A free-text level set here appears as an extra option in the Level picker.

## Limitations

- It notices edits made with Claude's Edit, Write and NotebookEdit tools, including by subagents. They aren't counted when files change **only** through shell commands, so with `show=changes` no offer appears. With `show=always`, or by running the skill yourself, the explanation still covers them, because the skill reads the real changes from git.
- With `show=changes`, offers appear only after the main conversation's turns finish with an answer, not after interrupted turns.

For development notes, see the [mod's README](https://github.com/Bergam0t/kompreni-claude-code-skill/blob/main/mods/kompreni-offer/README.md).
